title: ai-env
summary: A harness to run infrastructure with AI agents: the intelligence lives in the controls, not the model.
lead: A harness to run critical infrastructure with AI agents, with the rigor production demands.
problem: A language model is probabilistic and production demands determinism. Pasting thousands of lines into a chat hoping the model "remembers not to break anything" isn't engineering.
idea: Put the intelligence in the control scaffolding: separate control from execution, validate with schemas instead of asking the model nicely, send only the context needed and verify every result externally.
change: I work with agents that orchestrate tasks in isolated environments, never see credentials and close nothing without independent evidence. It installs itself on all my machines.
role: I designed, built and open-sourced it: the plugins, the agent workflows, the isolated-environment scripts and the verification rules.
note: Personal project. PRs and issues are welcome.
